A single night of 4 hour sleep can drop insulin sensitivity by up to 25%.

Your body handles carbs worse, stores more fat, and spikes glucose longer. Chronic poor sleep can lead to prediabetes.

What to do:
+ Prioritize 7.5+ hrs of sleep
+ Eat earlier (at least 4 hrs before bed)
+ No coffee 6 hours before bed
+ No heavy exercise 4 hours before bed
+ Keep your room dark and cool
+ Avoid blue light and screens 1–2 hrs before sleep

raw.author: DrKristieLeong
raw.text:
🚨 Want better blood sugar control without meds or extreme diets?
-
A simple handful of pistachios might be one of the most underrated tools for prediabetes.

Study: Eating 57g (≈2 oz) of pistachios daily for 2–4 months significantly lowered fasting glucose, insulin, and insulin resistance (HOMA-IR). 

It’s not just the healthy fats. Pistachios bring fiber, plant protein, polyphenols & phytonutrients that:

• Boost GLP-1
• Slash inflammation (IL-6, resistin)

Small habit.  Real metabolic results.
 
Backed by a solid randomized trial in Diabetes Care (2014).

Action Plan:

When you crave something crunchy, switch the chips for pistachios.

Who’s adding pistachios to their daily routine? 

Reference:

Hernández-Alonso et al., Diabetes Care (2014) 

#MetabolicHealth

raw.author: MichaelMindrum
raw.text:
Should we offer continuous glucose monitors (CGM) to patients with type 2 diabetes who aren't on insulin?  A recent NEJM published. tldr; YES. 

CONNECT (Oser et al., NEJM 2026) randomized 283 adults with HbA1c of 7.5% (58 mmol/mol) or higher at 22 US primary care practices. Both groups had six visits in 26 weeks, and a trial clinician reviewed glucose data and adjusted treatment at each one.

📊 HbA1c difference -0.9 points (95% CI -1.1 to -0.6), or -10 mmol/mol
📈 HbA1c below 7% (53 mmol/mol) in 46% with CGM vs 24% with usual care
📊 Glucose-lowering drugs were added in 31% vs 17%, mostly GLP-1 agonists
❌ Weight change did not differ (-2.5 vs -1.8 kg)
📊 Exploratory subgroups showed -2.1 points at HbA1c 10% (86 mmol/mol) or higher and -0.3 at 7.0 to 7.9%, with an interval crossing zero
🟢 No severe hypoglycemia, and 3 minor sensor-related bleeds

The case is strongest for patients well above target who also get planned follow-up. 

🏁 https://t.co/phHWXREabH
